mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if storm damage paint work is done too fast?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are hidden moisture, poor surface prep, color mismatch, and painting over damage that should have been repaired first. In Colorado’s freeze-thaw climate, a rushed repair can fail quickly if the surface is not dried, patched, and primed correctly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fast paint work can hide moisture, miss surface damage, and create color-matching problems. In Colorado weather, a poor repair can fail quickly if the area is not dried, patched, and primed correctly.
